name: Spellcraft Beginner Core
purpose: A genuinely small first Cuspell spellcraft progression chosen by Cuspell complexity rather than D&D spell level. It teaches immediate movement, simple state transitions, bounded yes/no discovery, and one fresh-creation pattern. The older 50-sign v0.1 file is retained as a broad coverage projection, not lesson one.
design_rules: prefer one-clause commands before programming/control structures
teach state Begin/End before persistence, prevention, collections, triggers, or concurrency
introduce Find only in its simple yes/no form
introduce Create with exactly one fresh binder and one immediate continuation
keep the first set free of And, Repeat, Persist, Prevent, Each, Collect, Member, Trigger, Represent, and TimeFlow
syntax_taught: name:Type / $name only for the first Create example
flat tight local application; parentheses are not required

first_actions.purpose: Six signs for the first useful spells: move, mend, and break.

target_and_condition.purpose: Add an explicit other target plus simple lock/illness states.

discovery.purpose: Add the caster reference and bounded factive yes/no Find.

creation_and_light.purpose: Add explicit location, fresh identity creation, attribute change, and Light for the first creation spell.

starter_spells.name: Move selected thing
starter_spells.note: Move an explicitly designated subject to an explicitly designated destination.

starter_spells.name: Move another person
starter_spells.note: Same Move pattern with the explicit addressee/target.

starter_spells.name: Mend
starter_spells.note: Begin the selected subject's Whole state.

starter_spells.name: Break
starter_spells.note: End structural wholeness of the selected subject.

starter_spells.name: Unlock
starter_spells.note: End the selected subject's Locked state.

starter_spells.name: Cause illness
starter_spells.note: Begin the target's pathological Ill state.

starter_spells.name: Remove illness
starter_spells.note: End the target's pathological Ill state.

starter_spells.name: Check whether it is locked
starter_spells.note: Acquire the truthful yes/no answer about whether the designated subject is Locked.

starter_spells.name: Diagnose illness
starter_spells.note: Acquire the truthful yes/no answer about whether the designated target is Ill.

starter_spells.name: Make an existing thing luminous
starter_spells.note: Set the selected existing Entity's Light output. This is deliberately not the beginner Light creation spell.

starter_spells.name: Create light here
starter_spells.cuspell: Create x:Entity At $x Here Change $x Light «LightUnit» @!
starter_spells.note: Allocate one fresh Entity at Here and immediately set its Light output. The exact visible orb/form is supplied only by a deterministic world generation profile, never guessed by the language.

starter_spells.name: Create light there
starter_spells.cuspell: Create x:Entity At $x There Change $x Light «LightUnit» @!
starter_spells.note: Same creation pattern at an explicitly designated destination.

deferred_modules.name: shared representation
deferred_modules.note: Teach only after basic Create; persistent illusion is composition, not a beginner primitive.

deferred_modules.name: programming and multi-target magic
deferred_modules.note: Deferred because these add control-flow/binding complexity rather than basic spell meaning.

deferred_modules.name: time manipulation
deferred_modules.note: Semantically compact but conceptually advanced; not needed for the first lesson.
